title: Apply for, replace, or renew a Mobility Parking Scheme permit (individual)
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for, replace, or renew a Mobility Parking Scheme (MPS) permit for individuals.
intro:
If you have a medical condition or disability that affects your mobility or vision, you may be eligible for a Mobility Parking Scheme (MPS) permit.

The permit lets you park in disability parking spaces. You can also park at no charge and for longer time periods in some parking areas.

who_can_apply: Cannot walk due to permanent or temporary loss of use of one or both legs, or other permanent medical or physical condition.
Physical condition is detrimentally affected by walking 100 metres.
Need to use a mobility aid (e.g., crutches, walking frame, callipers, scooter, wheelchair, or similar).
Note: Applicants with an intellectual, psychiatric, or cognitive impairment must meet at least one of the above eligibility criteria.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account (required if applying online).
The MyServiceNSW Account must belong to the applicant, not a representative.
Complete the Mobility Parking Scheme Application (PDF form).
Application form signatures must be signed with a pen and ink (wet ink signature); electronic signatures are not accepted.
If applying online, you may need details of two identity documents (e.g., Australian driver licence, Medicare card, or Australian passport).
If applying in person, check the specific requirements at a service centre.
Plastic Medicare card (not the digital version).
Pensioner Concession Card, Veterans Gold Card, or Centrelink Health Card details for a fee concession (if applicable).

how_to_steps.text: If your permit is about to expire, you should be sent a renewal notice about 6 weeks before the expiry date.
The renewal notice will provide you with the renewal process and advise you if you need to book an appointment with a medical doctor or specialist before you renew your permit.
Note: You will need to renew your NSW mobility parking permit before your old one expires.

### Displaying your permit
When you get an MPS permit, you'll also be issued an Australian Disability Parking permit (large purple card). You must display both permits to get parking concessions.
If the holder for the card is lost or damaged, you can visit a service centre to get a new one.

faqs.q: How do I renew my Mobility Parking Scheme permit?
faqs.a: If your permit is expiring, you should receive a renewal notice about 6 weeks before the expiry date. This notice will guide you through the renewal process and advise if you need to book an appointment with a medical doctor or specialist.

faqs.q: What are the eligibility criteria for an MPS permit?
faqs.a: You may be eligible if you cannot walk due to permanent or temporary loss of use of one or both legs, or another permanent medical or physical condition; if your physical condition is detrimentally affected by walking 100 metres; if you need to use a mobility aid like crutches, a walking frame, or a wheelchair; or if you are permanently blind.

faqs.q: Do I need to visit a service centre?
faqs.a: You will need to visit a service centre if you have a photo exemption but cannot apply online, or if your photo is significantly outdated (e.g., more than 10.5 years old).
